conclusion: gold E:13.57 is not reproducible under any of the 216 enumerated semantics combinations on the bundled dataset version; the canonical semantics give E=16.63 and E is the lowest-fee ACI among candidates (current ACI G excluded), so the letter half of the gold is defensible while the fee value is not. Model answers align with the enumerated space instead of the gold: B:54.21 equals the canonical candidate-B fee, and E:77.68 equals summing every matching rule (E:77.68 vs canonical E:16.63) — direct behavioural evidence that the undefined multi-rule tie-break splits answers. Question guidelines additionally mislabel the answer format ({card_scheme} instead of the ACI letter). Recorded as a grading-layer defect registration; formal scored rows and historical judgements are not modified.
